UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
C.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on February 23 and March 23; and special meeting on April 6 as written.
D-1.1. Feb 23 UB Minutes
D-1.2. March 23 UB Minutes
D-1.3. Apr 6 Spec UB Minutes
2.
Approval of Purchase of Terex PT70 Compact Loader and Authorize the Issuance of Purchase Order to RGW Equipment and Company. Recommendation: Approve the purchase of Terex PT70 Compact Track Loader from RGW Equipment for the Sludge Dewatering Retrofit Project W-281 at the Hsu-Canyon Water Treatment Plant in an amount of $79,480.85 and authorize the issuance of the purchase order.
D-2.1. Purchase of Compact Track Loader
D-2.2. PT70 RGW Quote
D-2.3. Terex PT70 Specifications
3.
Approval to Seek Bids for Project W-289 Water Main Replacement in a Portion of First Street and Azusa Avenue in the City of Azusa. Recommendation: Approve the advertisement for and solicitation of bids for Project W-289, Water Main Replacement in a portion of First Street and Azusa Avenue in the City of Azusa.
D-3.1. W-289 Water Replacement Project
D-3.2. W-289 Notice Inviting Bids
D-3.3. W-289 Plan
4.
Approval of Specifications for Project LD 2015-1 to Procure Pre-Assembled 12 KV Pole Mount Type Capacitor Banks and Advertise for Bids. Recommendation: Approve specifications for project LD2015-1 and authorize City Clerk office to advertise and solicit bids for the procurement of pre-assembled 12 kV pole mounted type capacitor banks.
D-4.1. LD-2015-1 Capacitor Banks Replacement
D-4.2. Capacitor Bank Specifications
5.
Approval of Resolution Allowing Continued Participation in the California Home Energy Renovation Opportunity (HERO) Program. Recommendations: Adopt attached Resolution No. UB-6-2015 approving an amendment to the Los Angeles County Energy Program ("LACEP") City Resolution in order to authorize the City's continued participation in the California HERO Program. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, STATE OF CALIFORNIA, CONSENTING TO INCLUSION OF PROPERTIES WITHIN THE INCORPORATED AREA OF THE CITY IN THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY ENERGY PROGRAM TO FINANCE DISTRIBUTED GENERATION RENEWABLE ENERGY SOURCES AND ENERGY AND WATER EFFICIENCY IMPROVEMENTS, APPROVING THE REPORT SETTING FORTH THE PARAMETERS OF THE REFERENCED PROGRAM AND CERTAIN MATTERS IN CONNECTION THEREWITH.
D-5.1. HERO Program Extension
D-5.2. Resolution-HERO Program
D-5.3. Approved UB Report 07-22-13
D-5.4. LACEP PACE Program Report
6.
Approval to Execute a Joint Audit Agreement with SCPPA for the Boulder Canyon Project (Hoover). Recommendation: Authorize the Director of Utilities to sign the Joint Audit Agreement with the Southern California Public Power Authority (SCPPA).
D-6.1. Hoover Audit
D-6.2. SCPPA Joint Audit Agreement
7.
Termination of Service Agreement with Portland General Electric Company. Recommendation: Authorize the Director of Utilities to execute the attached termination agreement with PGE.
D-7.1. PGE Service Agreement Termination
D-7.2. PGE Transmittal Letter
D-7.3. PGE Termination Agreement
8.
Extension of Time to Black & Veatch Professional Services Agreement for Integrated Resource Planning Consulting. Recommendation: Extend Black & Veatch (B&V) Professional Services Agreement supporting Azusa development of the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) to August 31, 2015.
D-8.1. Black & Veatch PSA Extension
D-8.2. B&V Restated and Amended PSA-Draft
E.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Authorization to Schedule and Notify Property Owners of Public Hearing for Refuse Rate Adjustment on June 15, 2015. Recommendation: Authorize staff to print and mail a 45-day advanced notice of public hearing to be held June 15, 2015 to consider the annual refuse rate adjustment.
E-1.1. Refuse Rate Adjustment
E-1.2. Refuse Rate Adjustment Calculations
E-1.3. 2015 Refuse Rate Public Hearing Notice
2.
Phase III Water Shortage Plan Continuation and Proposed Revisions to Water Rule 21 "Water Conservation." Recommendation: Ratify the City Manager and Utility Director's recommendation to continue Phase III Water Shortage declaration and amend Water Rule 21 to promote increased reductions in consumer and business water usage.
E-2.1. Water Rule 21 Amendment Report
E-2.2. Water Rule 21 Amendment Resolution
E-2.3. Redlined-Proposed Water Rule 21
E-2.4. Clean-Proposed Water Rule 21
E-2.5. SWRCB Mandatory Restrictions Gen Info
E-2.6. Fact Sheet 25% Implementation
